description: Clio calendar entries on a matter, now to 180 days. Recurring occurrences expanded; join links removed. `when` is firm-local; start_at is an ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC. Read-only. Sign-in required.

from.description: ISO-8601 window start. Defaults to now.

limit.description: Entries per page, earliest first, 1-100. Defaults to 50.

matter_id.description: Clio matter id (digits) from find_matter or list_open_matters. Not the display number.

page_token.description: next_page_token from the previous page. It carries the window; send the same limit.

to.description: ISO-8601 window end. Defaults to 180 days after from.

name: list_matter_calendar_events
title: List matter calendar events
